stories.title: Add JB News & Updates widget to homepage with curated RSS feed
stories.description: Implement a homepage widget that fetches and displays 3 latest news items from curated local RSS sources (JB tourism, travel blogs) to provide fresh content signals and encourage repeat visits for SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget renders 3 latest news items with title, excerpt (100 chars), publish date, and source link on homepage above fold
RSS parsing happens at build time (via ISR) and caches for 6 hours to prevent stale content
Each news item includes source attribution without rel=nofollow to credit and link to original sources

stories.title: Implement blog category taxonomy with filter UI and dynamic category pages

acceptanceCriteria: Blog index displays category filter that updates post list in real-time without page reload; selected category shows count

stories.title: Build Table of Contents component with scroll spy for blog posts
stories.description: Create auto-generated Table of Contents sidebar that extracts h2/h3 headings from blog posts and highlights current section as user scrolls to improve long-form content navigation and internal linking.
acceptanceCriteria: TableOfContents component extracts all h2 and h3 headings from post HTML and renders as nested list with proper indentation
Current section highlights dynamically via Intersection Observer API as user scrolls; highlight persists during scroll
Clicking TOC link smoothly scrolls page to heading with 80px offset (sticky header height) and updates URL hash

stories.title: Add estimated reading time calculation and display on blog posts
stories.description: Calculate and display estimated reading time (200 wpm baseline) on blog post cards, post headers, and collection pages to set user expectations and improve engagement signals for SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: calculateReadingTime(wordCount: number) function returns minutes as integer rounded up (1 min minimum); 100 words = 1 min
Reading time displays on /blog index cards below excerpt as '7 min read' in gray text (font-size: 14px)
Reading time displays on blog post header next to publication date with clock icon using Lucide or shadcn icon

stories.title: Implement client-side blog search with Fuse.js for real-time post discovery
stories.description: Add Fuse.js-powered search box to /blog page that enables real-time client-side filtering across blog post titles, excerpts, and categories without backend API calls to improve content discoverability.
acceptanceCriteria: Search input on /blog filters posts in real-time as user types (200ms debounce); results update incrementally
Fuse.js matches against post title (weight: 3), excerpt (weight: 2), and category (weight: 1) with fuzzy threshold 0.3
Matching terms are highlighted in results with <mark> tags; empty results state displays 'No posts found matching [query]'
